c.request: Using 0.149 as the peer correlation (`peercorr`) cutoff, take the advanced behaviour records with high peer correlation and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each combination of `translink` and order type mix (`ordertypedist`), count the matched records. For each combination, show the `translink`, the order type mix, the count, and the count as an unrounded fraction of the total count across all combinations with that same order type mix. Leave out combinations where the order type mix is missing. Sort by that fraction from highest to lowest and return the top 10. Only peer correlation values strictly greater than 0.149 pass the filter (more than 0.149).
c.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count, matched_count::numeric / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

a.request: Take the advanced behaviour records with a peer correlation (`peercorr`) greater than 0.149 and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each combination of `translink` and order type mix (`ordertypedist`), count the matched records. For each combination, show the `translink`, the order type mix, the count, and the count as an unrounded fraction of the total count across all combinations with that same order type mix. Leave out combinations where the order type mix is missing. Sort by that fraction from highest to lowest and return the top 10.
a.sql: WITH matched_counts AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count, matched_count::numeric / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM matched_counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: For advanced behaviour records with `peercorr > 0.149`, inner join transaction records on `transactionrecord.transreg = advancedbehavior.translink`, exclude null `ordertypedist`, and group by `translink` and `ordertypedist`. Return each group’s count and its unrounded count divided by the total count for that `ordertypedist`, sorted by the fraction descending, limited to 10 rows.
b.sql: SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS group_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior AS a INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For advanced behaviour records with `peercorr > 0.149`, join to transaction records on `advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg`, exclude unmatched records and rows with a missing `ordertypedist`, then group by `translink` and `ordertypedist`; return each group’s count and its unrounded count divided by the total count for that `ordertypedist`, ordered by that fraction descending, limited to 10 groups.
d.sql: SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS group_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior AS a INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
